2125058759705997510.en_summary: Charlie Bilello notes the $VIX fell 26% today, its 7th biggest one-day percentage decline in history. This is the 3rd time this month the $VIX has fallen more than 20% in a single day. The volatility of volatility has rarely been higher, with markets swinging from complacency to fear and back again quickly.
2125058759705997510.zh_summary: Charlie Bilello 指出 $VIX 今日下跌 26%，是歷史上第七大單日百分比跌幅。這是本月第三次 $VIX 單日下跌超過 20%。波動率的波動性極少如此高，市場從自滿迅速轉為恐懼再轉回。

2125058643154632845.en_summary: aleabitoreddit would revise AI capex estimates back up beyond accelerators after Jensen's return to $NVDA. Forecasts were revised down on him leaving, but return brings confidence in spend on upstream supply chains and bottlenecks. Jensen secures capacity for testing, substrates, lasers, memory that others like $GOOGL or Amazon need, forcing hyperscalers to be more aggressive in supply procurement.
2125058643154632845.zh_summary: aleabitoreddit 會將 AI 資本支出估計上調（超越加速器），因為 Jensen 重返 $NVDA。預測因他離開而下修，但他的回歸帶來對上游供應鏈及瓶頸支出的更多信心。Jensen 確保測試、基板、雷射、記憶體等其他如 $GOOGL 或 Amazon 所需的產能，迫使超大規模企業在供應採購上更加積極。

ticker_notes.NVDA: Jensen 回歸提升 AI 資本支出信心並確保關鍵產能

2125057192340697353.en_summary: Ben Bajarin says the semiconductor survey is consistent with supply chain reports. Weeks to inventory are at or near all-time lows. The quoted survey details Japanese manufacturers facing outbidding, shortages, low inventory (under 2 months for many), and disruptions from EOL notices, mentioning $NVDA $AMD $GOOGL $META $MSFT $AMZN $MU.
2125057192340697353.zh_summary: Ben Bajarin 表示半導體調查結果與供應鏈報告一致。庫存週數處於或接近歷史低位。所引用調查詳述日本製造商面對競價、短缺、低庫存（許多少於兩個月）及因 EOL 通知造成的干擾，提及 $NVDA、$AMD、$GOOGL、$META、$MSFT、$AMZN、$MU。

2125056333045219562.en_summary: aleabitoreddit finds $SMTC laser disclosures post-HieFo acquisition interesting. UHP 400mW lasers in development, behind $AAOI. Capacity to expand 3-4x by EOY to $25M/quarter laser revenue, another 3-4x next year to ~$100M/quarter. NPO engagements with 4 US and 3 Chinese hyperscalers, initial revenue Aug 2027-Jan 2028. CPO scale-up lasers beyond 2027. NPO is strong near-term. Strategy focuses on VHP/UHP for NPO/CPO and 3.2T pluggables. Behind commercially now but credible 2028 competitor. HieFo acquisition offers ~$300-400M 2027 annualized revenue opportunity, acquired for ~$34M.
2125056333045219562.zh_summary: aleabitoreddit 發現 $SMTC 在 HieFo 收購後的雷射披露很有趣。UHP 400mW 雷射開發中，落後於 $AAOI。產能年底擴張 3-4 倍至每季雷射收入 $25M，明年再擴 3-4 倍至約每季 $100M。與 4 家美國及 3 家中國超大規模企業 NPO 合作，初始收入 2027 年 8 月至 2028 年 1 月。CPO 規模化雷射貢獻超越 2027。NPO 是強勁近期機會。策略聚焦 VHP/UHP 用於 NPO/CPO 及 3.2T 可插拔。目前商業上落後但 2028 年是可信競爭者。HieFo 收購提供約 $300-400M 2027 年年度化收入機會，以約 $34M 取得。

ticker_notes.SMTC: HieFo 收購以低價取得，帶來 2027-2028 年雷射產能與收入機會
